threads.title: US data-center siting backlash after the midterms
threads.now: Democrat Gina Hinojosa unseated Texas Gov. Greg Abbott after campaigning for an immediate pause on new data-center permits. Wells Fargo puts 27% of planned U.S. data-center capacity in Texas; CNBC says CoreWeave fell 7% and Oracle 4.3%. A national exit poll found 57% of Tuesday's voters think AI will hurt society more than help, and 76% would oppose a new data center nearby.
threads.changed: Hinojosa beat Abbott on a data-center pause in the state Wells Fargo says holds 27% of planned U.S. capacity; a national exit poll found 76% would oppose a nearby data center.
threads.watch: Whether Hinojosa extends Abbott's September permit freeze past the December grid audit, and whether Georgia, Ohio or Pennsylvania follow with statewide pauses.

history.change: Created: Hinojosa wins Texas on a data-center pause; exit poll 57% AI-hurt / 76% local NIMBY.
